title: Tu Ali(as) ki karta hai hamsari
body:
Laa fatah illa ali laa saif illa zulfiqaar-2
Ye tere zameer ki bhool hai-2
Tujh me ali ki wilaa nahi-2
Teri bandagee bhi fuzool hai.
1) ye jo kar raha hai tu saqtiyaan,Mere pyaar ka hai ye intehaa-2
Tujhey taqth par bhi sukoon nahi,mujhey daar par bhi milee amaa
My adoo ko kyun na adoo kahoon-2
Meri zindaghi ka asool hai,
My maroon to lab pe ho ya ali-2
Mujhey aisa marna qubool hai.
2) wo ali jamaala e inaamaa,wo ali jo haasil e kulqafaa-2
Usey kya kahoon tu qud bataa,chalo tujhpe chora ye faisla,
Jisey haq ney baqshaa hai martaba-2
Jo azal shohar e batool hai
Rahaa jaagta to imam hai,kabhi sogayaa to rasool hai.
